name: zgeometry_triangulate_polygon_with_hole
description: zGeometry::TriangulatePolygonWithHole combines outer and inner rings, projects the inner ring to the cached plane, builds ring and bridge edges, emits triangles, and returns a triangle soup.
known_limits: The smoke validates a simple square-with-triangle-hole case and helper contracts; broader triangulation topology remains part of the coherent zGeometry triangulate-hole pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry triangulate-hole source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46c070 validates combined-count setup, global triangle/count reset, edge-state and combined-point allocation, outer/inner copies, plane cache, inner projection and caller-visible inner copyback, ring edge construction, bridge-edge attempts, active-edge collection, triangle emission, triangle-soup allocation/population, cleanup, and return.
The native triangulate-hole/orientation smoke verifies a square outer ring and triangular inner ring produce a nonempty triangle soup and project the caller-visible inner ring onto the outer plane.
